option_relations.rationale: Complement-mediated atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome (aHUS) is a distinct thrombotic microangiopathy from Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP).
Pancreatitis-Associated Thrombotic Microangiopathy is a descriptive term for a TMA occurring with pancreatitis, which could be HUS or TTP, but the option itself is not equivalent to TTP.
Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (HUS) is a distinct thrombotic microangiopathy from Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP).
Atypical Hemolytic Uremic Syndrome (aHUS) is a distinct thrombotic microangiopathy from Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP).
